request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Leech Lantern".

Creative brief
Name: Leech Lantern
Collection: Mirebound Court. Swamp creatures serving a drowned marsh court, marked by reeds, lilies, mud, spores, leeches, and deceptive water formations.
Core concept: A floating parasite that creates contracting rings of dark droplets.
Body and silhouette: Thick curled leech wrapped around a glowing marsh-light orb.
Signature features: Circular body, lamp-like central glow, and four dangling tendrils.
Palette and materials: Near-black purple, swamp green, murky red, and pale yellow light.
Movement personality: Drifting, pulsing, and quietly persistent.
Attack concept: Expands its body before releasing a wide ring of droplets that slows and then contracts back toward the lantern.
Directional details: One tendril on the lower-right side is noticeably shorter.
Avoid: Real lantern hardware, graphic parasite detail, extremely dark unreadable sprite.
